name: antigravity-blender
description: Google Antigravity native MCP plugin for Blender 4.5 LTS (ported from sixtysevenlf/dsh-blender-plugin): 6 core modeling tools (session/op/py/see/run/inspect), runtime bpy API introspection, sports-car Clearcoat & AgX studio LookDev presets, read-only scene resources, and modeling/sports-car skills.
suggestedPrompts: 检查 Blender 4.5 LTS 与 Antigravity Blender Gateway 连接状态并查看当前场景概览
按跑车全流程 SOP 从三视图测量开始搭建一辆现代超跑并配置 AgX 棚拍车漆
在当前 Blender 场景中做一次拓扑与装配审计，修复穿模与浮空件后回传四视图
